description: This file contains Go source code implementing HTML translation and processing functions, utilizing markdown parsing, HTML tokenization, and translation services within a content transformation pipeline.

classes.name: htmlReplacement
classes.description: A data structure representing a range of text in HTML content to be replaced with translated HTML.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Main function that processes a markdown body to translate embedded HTML blocks from source to target language using markdown parsing and HTML tokenization.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Helper function to determine the start and end positions of an HTML block within the source bytes.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies a list of replacements to the original body string, returning the updated HTML with translated segments.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts the list of replacements in ascending order based on their start position.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Translates the text content inside an HTML snippet, respecting tags that should be skipped during translation.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines whether a given piece of text should be translated based on its content and current skip depth.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if an HTML tag is one that should be skipped for translation (e.g., code, pre, script, style).
